name: Limit Switch
spec: Inductive sensor M8x1, PNP, normally closed, 2 mm flush, 10-30 V DC, built-in M8 3-pin plug
notes: One limit switch at each end of travel. Mass not yet checked against the datasheet.

name: Limit Switch Cable
spec: M8 3-pin A-coded socket, straight, to open ends, 2 m, PVC, rated for drag chains
notes: One cable per limit switch. Mass not yet checked against the datasheet.

name: End Stop Damper
spec: stroke 7 mm; length 16 mm; body 17 mm; impact face 15 mm; 22 mm when fully compressed; M4 stud 4 mm long; 1.7 Nm max; 6 Nm per stroke (9 Nm emergency stop)
notes: One damper at each corner of the carriage ends. Each is held by an M4 square nut in a slot in carriage-bottom.

name: Linear Encoder Read Head
spec: RSF AK MC 15 B absolute scanning head, BiSS C, 0.1 um step, 36 x 13.5 x 14.8 mm, 0.5 m cable, 15-pin D-sub; air gap 0.55 +-0.25 mm; 2 x M3 thread 26 mm apart, max 1.2 Nm
notes: On carriage-bottom with two M3 x 16 screws. Set the gap with the 0.55 mm gap foil that comes with the head. Ask RSF for the ID number of the 0.5 m cable before ordering.

name: Linear Encoder Scale
spec: RSF MC 15 MK absolute steel tape scale, 240 mm measuring length, 260 mm long, tape 8 x 0.25 mm on adhesive tape 6 x 0.2 mm, +-15 um/m
notes: Stuck on the inside of the side wall of the base with the TMT Mx 15 MK mounting tool. No end clamps.
